Notices for the syntax definitions in data/syntax-definitions.txt

Source: skylighting-core 0.15 as released on Hackage, directory `xml/` (https://hackage.haskell.org/package/skylighting-core-0.15, tarball SHA-256 485721e90b3f5e52369a11f08994969a224c038ae4c812734233ff3b30b6fa61, source repository https://github.com/jgm/skylighting). The files come from the KDE syntax-highlighting project (https://invent.kde.org/frameworks/syntax-highlighting).
